decisions.reason: The clear-on-activation behavior applies to applicable control fields but does not necessarily change the representation or architecture of ordinary text-entry fields.
Removing placeholder text on activation does not change the requirement for a visible cue identifying editable fields or resolve the existing grey-cue ambiguity.
The persistent hover label already preserves the field's initial purpose after its text is replaced or deleted; clearing field text on activation does not alter that label behavior.
The source does not change the calendar-dropdown selection method or clearly establish that date-picker fields are among the applicable fields whose placeholders clear on activation.
The source changes when applicable placeholder text is removed, not the Danish language or content of the stored interface and placeholder text.
Clear-on-activation behavior for control-field text is unrelated to Tab-based list hierarchy and indentation.
The control-field placeholder interaction does not change bullet size, balance, alignment, color, or visual design.
The source has no effect on numbered-list formatting or double-digit alignment.
The requested control-field activation behavior does not affect pasted table containment or column-layout stability.
The source does not change legacy-content transfer, formatting removal, layout stability, or style behavior during copy-paste.
Clearing placeholder text on field activation does not change the required theme color palette.
The source does not alter any heading, title, or caption typography requirement.
